upstream_copies_made: None. Originals are read in place by src/build.py and src/verify.py, which stop if a SHA-256 differs from the upstream delivery.json. No upstream file was modified.
panel_map: src/layout.json holds, for every variant, each panel's asset ID, source file, SHA-256, native size, exact placed x/y/w/h, scale_x/scale_y, aspect error, resampling method, frame rectangle, and the label and credit text boxes. evidence/placement-checks.json holds the pixel verification of those rectangles. delivery.json repeats the map under panel_map.
transformations: Decode to RGB (the GIFs are single-frame, fully opaque palette images; the JPEG is RGB).
Uniform scale to a whole-pixel rectangle with the source aspect ratio (rounding error at most 0.2 px on the long axis). Integer factors use nearest-neighbour; non-integer factors use Pillow LANCZOS.
Embed each scaled image as a PNG data: URI in the variant SVG at 1:1 device pixels, painted after every other element.
No crop, rotation, retouch, colour change, dimming, overlay, watermark removal, or partial use.
authored_additions: Panel labels: the exact ticket copy split at its separators (Business tools, Data entry, Utilities), Liberation Sans Bold 40 px (32 px on reduced context panels in focus variants).
Frame treatment, identical for all panels: #1b2027 mat 5 px wide plus a 2 px #343d48 stroke, entirely outside the image edges, on the #111318 production background.

Per-panel credits in Liberation Sans 26 px, taken from the upstream rights records as listed in evidence/source-excerpts.md. The XTRA-11 credit leaves off the software year on screen; the Microsoft statement is set in the brighter label colour on its own line.
Layouts: collage = three panels in one row at a common image height; focus variants = one panel enlarged on the left, the other two whole, reduced and credited on the right.
src/build.py, src/verify.py, src/finalize.py: deterministic authoring, pixel verification and delivery finishing scripts.
not_added: No capture date, year caption, version badge, statistic, user count, price, revenue, ranking, bank/hospital claim, customer data, logo, stock or office imagery.
